name: flan_t5_small_lora_test_input_v1
status: PINNED - NOT RUN. Uploading data (G-A) and installing packages / downloading the base model in Colab (G-B) each need separate approval.

base_model.revision_note: Hugging Face commit (lastModified 2023-10-10); config: 8+8 layers, d_model 512, 6 heads, d_kv 64, d_ff 1024, gated-gelu.

pinned_packages.note: transformers 5.22.2 = local inference version (.venv_ai); peft 0.21.2 fixes encoder-decoder models on transformers>=5.18; Trainer needs accelerate>=1.1.0.

runtime.torch_note: Colab's preinstalled CUDA build is used (not reinstalled); its version is recorded in TRAINING_MANIFEST.json.

lora.expected_trainable_note: Computed from the T5-small config (d_model 512, inner 384, d_ff 1024, 8 encoder + 8 decoder layers); confirm with print_trainable_parameters().

data.truncation: none - rows over the limits were removed by dev_tools/build_test_input_dataset.py

training.warmup_note: transformers 5.22.2 has no warmup_ratio argument; the notebook passes it as warmup_steps=0.03, which get_warmup_steps resolves to ceil(total_steps * 0.03) (8859 steps -> 266).
training.precision: fp32 (T5 is unstable in fp16; T4 has no bf16)
training.schedule_note: Periodic checkpoints every 500 of 8859 optimizer steps (17 saves + final); evaluation runs at the same steps because load_best_model_at_end requires save/eval alignment.

checkpointing.method: Trainer saves locally; a callback copies each finished checkpoint to a Drive staging folder, verifies SHA-256, writes FYP_CHECKPOINT_COMPLETE.json, then renames it to checkpoint-N. Resume restores the latest valid compatible checkpoint (and the best one) and calls trainer.train(resume_from_checkpoint=...) so optimizer, scheduler, RNG and global step continue.
checkpointing.vram_note: Measured locally: one worst-case batch (16 x 512 source, 16 x 257 target tokens, fp32, forward+backward) peaked at ~9.4 GiB on CPU; a T4 reports ~14.7 GiB.
checkpointing.storage_note: ~31.7 MB per checkpoint (fp32 adapter + AdamW states + state files); at most keep_last + best + one staging copy (~127 MB) on Drive, plus ~320 MB final export.

export.final_note: Export goes to <output>/final/ (must not exist), separate from <output>/checkpoints/.
export.manifest: TRAINING_MANIFEST.json with model_safetensors_sha256, dataset manifest sha256, config, library versions, GPU, losses, wall time
export.local_install_path: models/test_input_generator_v1 (git-ignored); loaded by ai_test_input_service.py with plain transformers (no peft)

evaluation.report: validation heldout subset; compared with the deterministic baseline
evaluation.test_split: evaluated once at the end only with separate approval
